auth.demoSignIn: Sign in with a demo account

overview.readyDescription: Your tenant is provisioned and ready. Here's where most teams start.

profile.loadWarning: Couldn't load your profile. Showing details from your session; saved changes may not reflect the latest server state.
profile.photoDescription: Shown in the topbar and on your activity. Square crops work best — JPG, PNG, or WebP.
profile.identityDescription: Your name and contact details, visible across the dashboard.
profile.emailHint: Contact your tenant admin to change your sign-in email.
profile.subjectDescription: The unique ID this account uses inside the platform. Read-only.

security.sessionsDescription: Browsers and devices currently signed in to your account.
security.noSessionsDescription: Session activity will appear here once you sign in from any device.

appearance.themeDescription: Pick a colour mode for the dashboard. System follows your OS.
appearance.accentDescription: Pick the brand colour used for primary actions, charts, and highlights across the dashboard.
appearance.fontDescription: The UI typeface. Mono code blocks always use JetBrains Mono.
appearance.densityDescription: Compact mode reduces card padding and row height for data-dense screens.
appearance.compactSpacing: Use compact spacing across the dashboard.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Choose which events you want delivered as email or in-app notifications.
notifications.explanation: In-app notifications are already delivered to your bell — open it from the top bar to see them. Granular per-event email opt-ins are on the v1.1 roadmap. In the meantime, your tenant admin can disable email delivery globally.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Long-lived credentials used by services to call the FSH API. Treat them like passwords.
apiKeys.explanation: Personal access tokens and service-to-service API keys are on the v1.1 roadmap. For now, your access flows through the user-bound JWT issued at sign-in. Track progress on the public roadmap or watch the next release notes.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Your tenant's billing history, newest first.
invoices.searchPlaceholder: Search by invoice number, status, or period…
invoices.noResultsDescription: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the search.
invoices.emptyDescription: Once your tenant has been billed for a period, invoices will appear here.

activity.title: Live activity
activity.description: Full event log streamed from the API over Server-Sent Events.
activity.streamOpen: The stream is open. Events will appear here as the backend publishes them.
activity.streamOffline: The activity stream is not connected. Events will queue once the connection comes online.

audits.title: Audit trail
audits.description: Activity, security, entity-change, and exception events across the platform. Window enforced server-side; max 90 days.
audits.emptyDescription: Try widening the time range or relaxing the filters. Activity events arrive as soon as the platform handles a request.

invoiceDetail.noLineItemsDescription: This invoice has no itemized charges.

topbar.signOutDescription: You'll need to sign in again to access this tenant. Any unsaved work in this session will be lost.

errors.validationFailed: One or more validation errors occurred.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
